history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

The 3-bedroom Type A is 900 sq. ft., with 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor, with a small storage area too. For a rough monthly figure, maintenance is about RM162 (900 sq. ft. × RM0.18), inclusive of sinking fund, subject to latest project confirmation. That’s the maintenance fee only—not your loan instalment or utilities; selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use. Are you looking at it for your own stay or as an investment?
It would be for our own stay. Could you let me know the current Type A price and whether there are any other mandatory regular charges? I’d like to understand the overall cost before going further.

That makes sense—you’d want the full cost picture before deciding whether to go further. The price reference I have lists Type A base prices from RM328k to RM358k depending on category and floor, but that isn’t a confirmed current unit price or total; the car-park configuration and current package can affect it. The only recurring project charge I can verify so far is the estimated RM162/month maintenance, inclusive of sinking fund. Selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use; I can’t yet confirm whether there are any other mandatory regular charges. I’ll verify the latest price and charge details before giving you an overall figure.
